description.value: Hog Shack Cook House bills itself as Steveston's first and only BBQ and casual cookhouse, specializing in Kansas City-style smoked meats with all rubs and sauces made in-house from scratch. The restaurant is distinctive for its 100% craft beer list — no mass-market brands — curated specifically to pair with their smoked dishes. Located in Steveston Village, a popular destination along Richmond's extensive waterfront dyke cycling network, it offers a relaxed, kid-friendly dine-in experience with four HD TVs and a casual atmosphere.
